versions.content: Description of Data Identifiers Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the description of Data Identifiers for Diagnostic Services. Rationale: The definition of Data Identifiers is a central part of the configuration of the AUTOSAR diagnostic stack. Use Case: The user wants to define a Diagnostic Data Identifier with a given content. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: More information can be found in the specification of the AUTOSAR Diagnostic Communication Manager [3].
